stop_condition: Terminal stop when cumulative online active-wall time reaches 172800 seconds; successful repository integration may finish earlier
green_policy: Authoritative fixed-contract GREEN is correctness evidence and reported progress only; it never resets or changes the active-wall limit
counted_online_phases: Runtime, provider, theory, prefix and heap initialization or preparation
Model reasoning, retrieval, editing, helper work and retries
Candidate, contract and full native checks
Seal, seal diagnosis and repair, and integration
Ordinary waits while the experiment process is online
excluded_intervals: Process downtime between durable pause/checkpoint and explicit resume
Confirmed provider interruption and recovery after a provider failure
continuation_mode: explicit same-output workspace-level resume with a new model thread after abnormal interruption only
resume_policy: Preserve cumulative active-wall time, usage, GREEN state, plan and workspace. The 172800-second limit is terminal, cannot be extended, and cannot be resumed or reset
allocation_policy: Plan once before generation; after acceptance, theory membership, contract assignment, imports and execution order are immutable
workspace_policy: All planned theories remain in one shared workspace; sharing storage does not authorize unsealed cross-theory premises
seal_policy: When all contracts in a theory are GREEN, automatically attempt seal; use diagnostics to repair and retry without changing the frozen plan
token_accounting_policy: Continue recording authoritative cumulative provider usage and shared-cost attribution for evaluation; token values never stop the experiment
binding_notice: Fresh runs bind input, source, plan, model, active-wall policy and limit. Existing runs under any older budget policy are rejected without migration or clock reset
